question_text: A 42-year-old woman presents to the urgent care clinic with recurrent chest pain and pressure radiating to her jaw. ECG is obtained and shows ST-segment elevation, but her cardiac enzymes are repeatedly found to be within normal ranges. She has a heart rate of 82/min and a blood pressure of 128/76 mm Hg. Physical examination reveals regular heart sounds with no friction rub. Which of the following options is an acceptable treatment regimen for this patient’s suspected condition?
